content: संधिः .²1 Union, junction, combination, connection; संधये सरला सूची वक्रा छेदाय कर्तरी <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>Me. 60</ls>. .²2 A compact, an agreement. .²3 Alliance, league, friendship, peace, treaty of peace (one of the six expedients to be used in foreign politics); कति प्रकाराः संधीनां भवन्ति <ls>H. 4</ls>; (the several kinds are described in <ls>H. 4. 106-125</ls>); शत्रुणा न हि संदध्यात् सुश्लिष्टेनापि संधिना <ls>H. 1. 85</ls>. .²4 A joint, articulation (of the body); तुरगानुधावनकाण्डितसंधेः <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²5 A fold (of a garment). .²6 A breach, hole, chasm. .²7 Especially a mine, chasm or opening made by thieves in a wall or underneath a building; संधिं छित्त्वा तु ये चौर्यं रात्रौ कुर्वन्ति तस्कराः <ls>Ms. 9. 276</ls>; वृक्षवाटिकापरिसरे संधिं कृत्वा प्रविष्टोऽस्मि मध्यमकम् <ls>Mk. 3</ls>. .²8 Separation, division. .²9 Euphony, euphonic junction or coalition (in <ab>gram.</ab>) .²10 An interval, a pause. .²11 A critical juncture. .²12 An opportune moment. .²13 A period at the expiration of each {%Yuga%} or age; त्रेताद्वापरयोः संधौ <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 3</ls>. .²14 A division or joint (in a drama); (they are five; see <ls>S. D. 330-332</ls>); तौ संधिषु व्यञ्जितवृत्तिभेदम् <ls>Ku. 7. 91</ls>. .²15 The vulva. .²16 Distillation. .²17 Land <ab>etc.</ab> donated for the worship of temple-deities <ab>etc.</ab> (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Dr. Raghavanʼs note</ls> on वृत्तिसन्धिप्रतिपादकः <ls>Chola-Champū.</ls> p. 1 “संधिः देवपूजार्थमतिसृष्टं तादृशं भूम्यादिकं संधिपदस्य द्रविडदेवालयशिलाशासनेषु तादृशेऽर्थे व्यवहारदर्शनात् .”). .²18 Contrivance, management; तस्य सावरणदृष्टसंधयः काम्यवस्तुषु नवेषु संगिनः <ls>R. 19. 16</ls>. .²19 Twilight. .²20 A seam. .²21 The connecting link of a perpendicular (in mensuration). .²22 The common side of double triangle.
